description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. is a technology innovator enabling next-generation experiences and digital transformation for a smarter, connected future. The company is seeking an entry-level Backend Software Engineer to build and maintain cloud services, microservices, APIs, and event pipelines for device management and IoT security. The role involves coding, testing, debugging, monitoring, and collaborating with product, QA, and engineering teams.
Backend software engineer building cloud SaaS microservices, REST APIs, event listeners, and data models

Responsibilities:
• Work with a group of talented engineers to build and maintain backend microservices for the Compute Sentra SaaS platform
• Implement REST APIs, event listeners, and data models under the guidance of senior engineers
• Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to learn and uphold team standards
• Be exposed to modern AI-assisted software development, using AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging as part of our everyday engineering workflow
• Help troubleshoot, debug, and monitor services running in our cloud environment
• Collaborate with cross-functional teammates — product, QA, and other engineers — to deliver features end to end

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
• B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
• Foundational programming experience in an object-oriented language (Java, Kotlin, C#, or similar), through coursework, internships, or personal projects
• Familiarity with relational databases and SQL fundamentals
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Fluent English
• Must be able to work on-site in San Diego, CA

Preferred:
• Exposure to server-side frameworks such as Spring / Spring Boot (Java) or equivalents (Flask, FastAPI, .NET)
• Understanding of REST API design and HTTP fundamentals
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
• Basic understanding of microservices architecture
• Any exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
• Excellent problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn
• Any exposure to working with AI coding assistants such as Claude or Codex
• Coursework or projects involving distributed systems, messaging (Kafka), or event-driven design
• Familiarity with PostgreSQL or other relational databases
• Exposure to containers and Kubernetes (Docker, k8s)
• Awareness of Clean Code, SOLID, and sound software engineering practices
• Interest in IoT, device management, or security
